bio.text: Eric Toney, a Republican, is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for Wisconsin Attorney General after advancing from the August 11 Republican primary.
He was elected Fond du Lac County district attorney in 2012 and re-elected in 2016 and 2020; before that he was an attorney at O'Rourke Law Offices.

Toney graduated from Fond du Lac High School, earned a bachelor's degree in history and political science from St. Norbert College in 2006 and a law degree from Mitchell Hamline School of Law in 2009.
